message.subject: Collaborating on practical classroom technology resources
message.email_body: Helping students get academic support late at night when teachers are unavailable is a constant challenge. Your video on building a Socratic tutor to answer questions late at night caught our attention. At EDXSO, we want to propose an exploratory co-created educational resource about practical technology in schools to help educators easily integrate classroom AI. I invite you to reply if a short call this month would suit you.
